core.title: 77 Inch Wood Frame Inswing Double Door Security Door Bars,  ESI-SB-07-UV77
tags: 77 Inch Wood Frame Inswing Double Door Security Door Bars

text.description_html:
Wood Frame Inswing Double Door Security Door Bar

Heavy duty steel security bars for Double Inswing doors (pair of doors) 60" to 72" wide (maximum 72" door width) with a Wood Stud Frame.

These exit door security bars feature a unique, patented, hook-on / lift-off operation that is easy to use and emergency sensitive.

Easy to install! No special tools required! Each package includes caution sign, and installation hardware. 5" long wood screws are included to securely fasten the Locking Cradle and Locking Receiver to wooden door studs.


For use on Wood Door Frames. The 1-1/4" 16 gauge square steel tubing lift-off security bar secures the door entry so the doors can not be forced inward. (Actual length of the 1-1/4" security bar: 77" long.)

The heavy duty steel security bars are finished in gray powder coat epoxy baked to a semi-gloss.

Available in other sizes for inswing doors (Measure the door width - NOT the door frame width).

  • ESI-SB-03-UV48 - Metal Frame Inswing Single Door up to 48"
  • ESI-SB-07-UV48 - Wood Frame Inswing Double Door up to 48"
  • ESI-SB-03-UV72 - Metal Frame Inswing Double Door up to 72"

    • Available in other sizes for outswing doors (Measure the door width - NOT the door frame width).

  • ESI-SB-01-0030 - Outswing Single Door up to 30"
  • ESI-SB-01-0036 - Outswing Single Door 31" - 36" (Most Common)
  • ESI-SB-01-0042 - Outswing Single Door 37" - 42"
  • ESI-SB-01-0048 - Outswing Single Door 43" - 48"
  • ESI-SB-01-0060 - Outswing Double Door 60"
  • ESI-SB-01-0072 - Outswing Double Door 72"
  • ESI-SB-01-0084 - Outswing Double Door 84"
  • ESI-SB-01-0096 - Outswing Double Door 96"

    • You can cut the bar to length. Meaning, if you need the bar to be 60", you will cut down the security bar. All installation hardware is included.
